research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: iSono Health is engaged in research and development of a wearable ultrasound system and method, as described in the title and abstract. The system includes a scanner module with an ultrasound transducer, rotational actuator, and electronics, as well as a positioner module, enabling operability in multiple modes. This work focuses on advancing accessible and personalized breast health monitoring through innovative ultrasound technology and system integration.
